clues: This large city in France sits on the lower Loire River. The river runs from here toward the wide Atlantic coast.
Soft air from the Atlantic keeps winters mild in this inland city. That same inland spot makes warm days come more often in summer.
In the year 732, a great fight took place near this city. That fight is still the thing this place is best known for.
One of the biggest arenas of the old Roman world stands in this city. Few arenas from that age were built on such a scale.
The old heart of this city has a place on the UNESCO World Heritage list. That list holds the most prized old places on Earth.
